title: Rav Zuti of the School of Rav Pappi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned under this name in Shabbat 157a and Nedarim 77a: “for Rav Zuti of the school of Rav Pappi taught,” from which Hyman infers that he lived in Rav Ashi’s time, since in Shabbat there Rav Ashi says, “But we learned,” etc. Likewise in Yevamot 25b: “Rav Zuti of the school of Rav Pappi taught it,” referring to the words of Rav Kahana and Rav Ashi.
Hyman suggests that he was the reciter of baraitot in Rav Pappi’s academy.

notes.text: תני denotes reciting a baraita here. Hyman infers contemporaneity with Rav Ashi and proposes an academy-reciter role; neither claim makes Rav Zuti a Tanna of the Mishnaic generation.
The consulted Shabbat 157a directly names Rav Zuti of Rav Pappi’s school as a baraita reciter. Hyman’s chronology and academy role remain inferences from the cited discussion.
